name: JCC MetroWest Exploration Camp
description_short: Weekly themed day camp at the JCC MetroWest building in West Orange for children entering K to grade 3, with three hours a day of teacher led instruction in topics like LEGO architecture, cooking, crafts and science, plus a daily free swim and games.
special_needs_notes: Inclusive camp; families of campers who need extra support contact the JCC's inclusion staff.
swim_waterfront_notes: Daily free swim in the JCC's indoor heated pools.
notes: Camp 9 am to 4 pm; aftercare 4 to 5 pm. Two week minimum; savings for all seven weeks. Lunch is included Mondays and Tuesdays; families send lunch Wednesday to Friday. Fees are not posted.
